content:
ashley: quick alert - us-west1 AZ-b nodes seeing attach stalls during a GPU scale. nvme write ops ~350/s with avg size ~4KB, p99 write latency ~14ms. 15 attaches queued.
jamie: any recent janitor/compactor runs?
ashley: yes, compactor backfill started 02:05z and overlapped the scale.
riley: small metadata writes + fsync bursts will destroy queue depth. Can we pause compaction on low-priority pools?
devin: cautious but reasonable for 30m. Command: `infractl patch-janitor --region us-west1 --pool ephemeral-lowprio --pause 1800`
ops: also spin a 10% canary enabling metadata batching (200ms) to reduce per-file fsyncs.
ashley: applied pause to 8 hosts. immediate drop: w/s 380 -> 120 and attaches down to 4 within 90s.
jamie: good signal. leo-note: add alert for "high write ops with small avg size + wear_delta" to catch next time.
sre-bot: incident tagged.
jamie: actions: extend pause to remaining flagged hosts if canary stable, roll metadata_batch to 30%, ops to model cost of deferred compaction.
ashley: will follow up with charts and a runbook PR for surgical backfill pauses.
